newsitem.title: USA: Holder weighs acquiring Video Lottery unit.
newsitem.headline: Holder weighs acquiring Video Lottery unit.

text.p: New York investor William Spier said Thursday he has told the board of Video Lottery Technologies Inc of his interest in exploring a possible acquisition of the company's Automated Wagering International unit.

Spier, who controls a 14.4 percent stake in the company, said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing that any possible deal may be done by him or all or certain of the parties included in his filing.
In addition, such a deal may be possibly be done by William Lyons, a director of Video Lottery and other third parties, he said in the filing.
He said there was no assurance that any proposal will be made to the company or that any transaction will result.
